items.note: A phase-specific multi-agent LLM system was deployed in two innovation hackathons (pilot plus follow-up study) and the abstract reports that it preserves idea diversity, but it does not state a comparison condition or N; next stage must check whether the follow-up had a control arm or is a system paper without comparison.
Rapid ideation workshop where 21 participants brainstormed alone and with an LLM, comparing variety and quality of ideas (within-person, order not stated); below the 50-participant threshold.

Two sequential behavioral experiments on generative-AI support for advertising practitioners crossed with implicit-theory type, scoring fluency, flexibility, and originality of creative output; a third study measures viewers' attitudes to AI-assisted work; N not in abstract.

Within-subject experiment with 20 HCI researchers comparing breadth-first and depth-first LLM research-question generation (CoQuest); creativity outcomes are perceived, but number of generated RQs is counted; same study as arXiv 2310.06155; below 50.

Mixed-methods study with 54 researchers using an agentic research-ideation system at three control levels (AI configuration comparison); abstract reports only perceived creativity support, effort, and ownership, so check whether idea quality was rated; may be self_report_only.

Exploratory user study of a children's tabletop storytelling system comparing AI-generated story-situated writing instructions with fixed prompts on writing complexity, richness, and quality; N and assignment not stated.

User studies of PersonaFlow (LLM-simulated expert personas for research ideation) versus alternative designs report only perceived relevance and creativity of research directions, critical-thinking activities, cognitive load, and agency; same study as arXiv 2409.12538.

73 children aged 4-8 co-created oral stories with either an AI agent or a human partner, comparing response styles and narrative features of the children's contributions; no creativity rating stated; abstract from Semantic Scholar (OpenAlex returned none).

Comparative experiments on AI-powered idea funnelling (ChatGPT, Gemini) and hybrid AI-human engineering design teams judged on feasibility, relevance, and innovation quality; unclear whether any human-participant comparison exists or whether it is mostly model-only.

Information Systems Research paper reporting that brief explanations and examples of Idea Co-Development with GenAI raise joint human-GenAI creativity over repeated co-creation; design, N, and creativity measure not stated in the abstract; AOM proceedings versions exist.
